<thought>Based on the 1H NMR data (3 H singlet at 3.81 ppm for a methoxy group, two aromatic doublets each integrating to 2 H indicating a para‑disubstituted benzene, and two triplets each 2 H at 2.58 and 2.84 ppm characteristic of a –CH₂‑CH₂‑ chain attached to an aromatic ring and a carbonyl), the structure that fits is 4‑methoxyphenylpropionic acid. Its SMILES notation is “COc1ccc(cc1)CCC(=O)O”.</thought>
<final_answer>COc1ccc(cc1)CCC(=O)O</final_answer>
